notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
description:
Declare the creature that has Infantry Shield attached as an attacker. The creature triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking equal to the creature's power.
During your postcombat main phase, activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Warriors, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.name: Infantry Shield
uses.cardState: attached to a creature you control with power 5 or greater that does not have summoning sickness
